add_expense:
(defn add_expense
  ([amount category] (add_expense amount category nil))
  ([amount category note]
   (when-not (and (number? amount) (pos? amount)) (throw (ex-info "amount must be positive" {})))
   (when-not (and (string? category) (not (blank? category))) (throw (ex-info "category must be a non-empty string" {})))
   (when-not (or (nil? note) (string? note)) (throw (ex-info "note must be a string" {})))
   (let [base {"amount" amount "category" category}
         e (if (string? note) (assoc base "note" note) base)]
     (swap-state! update "expenses" (fnil conj []) e)
     (count (get (state) "expenses")))))
by_category:
(defn by_category []
  (let [grouped (reduce (fn [m e]
                          (update m (get e "category") (fnil + 0) (round (* 100 (get e "amount")))))
                        {} (get (state) "expenses" []))]
    (reduce (fn [m k] (assoc m k (/ (round (get grouped k)) 100))) {} (sort (keys grouped)))))
set_budget:
(defn set_budget [category amount]
  (when-not (and (string? category) (not (blank? category)))
    (throw (ex-info "category is required" {})))
  (when-not (and (number? amount) (not (< amount 0)))
    (throw (ex-info "budget must be zero or more" {})))
  (swap-state! assoc-in ["budgets" category] (from_cents (to_cents amount)))
  (get (state) "budgets"))
over_budget:
(defn over_budget []
  (let [budgets (get (state) "budgets" {})
        spent (reduce (fn [m e] (update m (get e "category") (fnil + 0) (to_cents (get e "amount"))))
                      {} (get (state) "expenses" []))]
    (vec (sort (filter (fn [c] (> (get spent c 0) (to_cents (get budgets c)))) (keys budgets))))))
top_category:
(defn top_category []
  (let [spent (reduce (fn [m e] (update m (get e "category") (fnil + 0) (to_cents (get e "amount"))))
                      {} (get (state) "expenses" []))]
    (when (seq spent)
      (reduce (fn [a c] (if (> (get spent c) (get spent a)) c a)) (first (sort (keys spent))) (keys spent)))))
